description: This file is a Node.js script that verifies the presence and correctness of plugin SDK artifacts such as exports, subpath files, and generated type maps in the build output directory. It checks for missing exports and files, and ensures that the generated facade type map does not leak internal module imports.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Main logic performing the verification checks on exports, files, and generated content, exiting with error if any are missing.
